title: Backpack video drone
headline: Fold a front arm without lining its propeller up first, and the blade hits the side panel and the deck stack.

claim.text: No unexpected collisions (140 samples, props always parked)

notes: Parked the way the README says, the props clear by 17 mm.
At full fold, about half of all propeller angles collide. Nothing in the hardware stops it; it relies on the operator.
